## 2026-08-31 04:44 UTC — [Pillar 2] Next block rejects 03 UTC rebound and high-edge entries

**Task:** Settle the next Smart Entry block, test whether the prior 03 UTC reversal survives independent observations, and evaluate whether side or edge segmentation produces a robust filter improvement.
**Finding:** Public-GET settlement appended 12 validated rows, growing the immutable ledger from 5,179 to 5,191 with market 3992217 pending; validation passed. The block was only 2/12 with -67.63% mean, -100% median, -82.68% leave-best-out, and -11.27% SolSt1ne. All four 03 UTC rows lost -100%, directly rejecting the prior local 5/8 rebound. The eight 04 UTC rows were 2/8 but remained strongly adverse at -51.44% mean, -100% median, -72.79% leave-best-out, and -12.86% SolSt1ne. NO was 0/3 and -100% throughout; YES was 2/9 with -56.83% mean and -76.19% leave-best-out. Edge >=0.22 was 0/3 and -100%, while edge <0.22 was only 2/9 and remained robustly negative. The prospective 0.30–0.40 saturated band grew to n=84 across three dates and retained a stable negative conclusion: -31.39% mean, -100% median, -35.69% leave-best-out, and a fully negative [-54.30%, -7.12%] bootstrap interval. The adjacent-band contrasts still include zero, so the evidence supports a broad veto rather than a finely tuned cutoff.
**My thinking:** This is the independent falsification the earlier side-transfer conflict required. The 03 UTC rebound did not merely weaken—it went 0/4—and neither direction nor edge tier rescued the block. Because adjacent saturated bands are not statistically separable and only three dates are represented, tightening to a bespoke raw-edge boundary would be overfitting; the defensible action is to preserve the existing research vetoes.
**Decision:** Classify `P2_03UTC_REBOUND_REJECTED_NEXT_BLOCK_HIGH_EDGE_ZERO_FOR_THREE`. Reject the 03 UTC hour-side candidate, preserve the >=0.22 and 0.30–0.40 saturated-band vetoes, five-date minimum, robust median/leave-best-out requirements, and research-only status. Make no live parameter, execution, configuration, trade, or retired-bot change.
**Next:** Settle market 3992217, continue regime-tagged collection through 04 UTC, and test an orthogonal volatility/cascade-state filter only after pre-registration; do not search additional hour, side, or edge cutoffs on this block.
